name: ethics-for-ai-mcp
title: Ethics for AI — MCP Server (daily ethics feed for agents)
description: A remote MCP server that publishes a deterministic daily ethics feed for AI agents, drawn from a four-module curriculum (Humanity’s Goals, Core Principles, Case Studies, Code of Conduct). 10 read-only tools, 9 ethics:// resources, 1 reflection prompt. Zero upstream cost. Pay-per-event: only tools/call is metered.
